svg.text: Circuit breaker on Azure: four ways to call a failing dependency
One order API, one unreliable payment provider. The path decides what an outage costs.
Counts every call that reaches it
naive: plain HttpClient, every caller waits for the provider
fallback: breaker open? Park the payment, answer 202
charge with the same idempotency key
breaker still open: reschedule with a delay, do not throw
